question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $N,$ given by

$$
N=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & -9 & 3 \\ -3 & 2 & 5 \\ 3 & 5 & -9\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2}$ on $N?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2}$ means that we need to swap the first and second rows.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}N &= \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-1 & -9 & 3 \\ -3 & 2 & 5 \\ 3 & 5 & -9\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-3 & 2 & 5 \\ -1 & -9 & 3 \\ 3 & 5 & -9\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$
